plugins.name: qualflare
plugins.description: Test management & reporting for Claude Code via Qualflare CLI
plugins.longDescription:
Qualflare gives Claude Code a persistent, project-aware view of your test suite. After a one-time /qf-init, every session starts with full context about your frameworks, package layout, naming conventions, and live file counts — so /qf-cover, /qf-run, and /qf-fix work intelligently from the very first message.

Key commands:
  /qf-init   — first-time project setup (detects frameworks, configures auth)
  /qf-cover  — generate tests for recently changed source files
  /qf-run    — run your test suite and upload results to Qualflare
  /qf-fix    — diagnose and fix failing tests from the last run
  /qf-doctor — health check: CLI, auth, config, drift, tooling
  /qf-update — refresh file counts without re-running full setup
  /qf-state  — inspect what Qualflare knows about this project
  /qf-hook on|off — toggle the end-of-session coverage nudge
